Internal view returning whether an address is exempt from burn logic.
View computing the current TWAP average without persisting state.
View returning the last stored TWAP average price.

Balance destruction called on the sender inside the overridden transfer.

Fixed point / cumulative price arithmetic including unguarded subtraction of block timestamps.

IERC20 token being released in the vesting contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender from _msgSender becomes the initial owner written in the constructor.
block.timestamp determines the burn reserve vault release time created by the constructor.
constructor calls setMinDeltaTwap during deployment.
constructor indirectly calls setWhitelistedSender via _distributeTokens, _initializePair and vault creation.
constructor assigns the immutable initial distribution address.
mint is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to the owner.
mint invokes ERC20._mint to create new supply.
setMinDeltaTwap is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
initializeTwap is restricted to the initial distribution address via msg.sender.
setWhitelistedSender is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_transfer modifier whenNotPausedOrInitialDistribution compares msg.sender to the distribution address.
unpause is restricted by onlyInitialDistributionAddress.
initializeTwap consumes the block timestamp returned by the uniswap oracle library.
_updateTwap uses block.timestamp to compute the elapsed TWAP window.
getCurrentTwap reads the current block timestamp for counterfactual pricing.
vestedAmount branches on block.timestamp relative to cliff and start+duration.
TokenTimelock.release requires block.timestamp to exceed the stored release time.
_isWhitelistedSender reads the whitelistedSenders mapping.
_transfer consults whitelist status to decide whether to apply burn logic.
isThisToken0 selects whether price0Cumulative or price1Cumulative is used.
minDeltaTwap is compared against the elapsed time before refreshing the oracle.
blockTimestampLast is read and overwritten by _updateTwap.
priceAverageLast is updated and returned by _updateTwap.
getLastTwap returns the stored priceAverageLast value.
_updateTwap queries the uniswap pair stored in uniswapPair.
getCurrentTwap queries the uniswap pair for cumulative prices.
INITIAL_TOKENS_PER_ETH is the baseline compared against the current TWAP during burn scaling.
BURN_PCT seeds the burn percentage computation in _transfer.
_transfer invokes _updateTwap to obtain the current token price.
_transfer invokes _isWhitelistedSender to test burn exemption.
_transfer performs chained mul/div math to derive currentBurnPct and burn amounts.
_transfer calls ERC20._burn on the sender with the computed burn amount.
TokenVesting.release performs an external safeTransfer to the beneficiary after state update.
_updateTwap performs fixed point cumulative price arithmetic with unchecked subtractions.
getCurrentTwap performs the same fixed point cumulative price arithmetic.
The external token transfer hands control to an arbitrary token contract which may re-enter release.
TokenTimelock.release makes an external safeTransfer that can call back into the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter is a plain argument that flows directly into the state-var setter for TWAP delta.
The IERC20 parameter only exists to select the token operated on by release.
Unreleased amount is a temporary value consumed entirely inside release.
The burn percentage local is an intermediate of the multiplication/division burn computation.
The total burn amount local is a direct product of the burn arithmetic before splitting.
The current TWAP-derived price local is produced by the oracle arithmetic.
The elapsed-seconds local is an intermediate of the TWAP cumulative price arithmetic.
